display.purpose: The name in the hero only.

prose.purpose: Readable paragraphs in IBM Plex Sans, 72ch max.

motion.name: colour-fade
motion.purpose: Links, buttons and summaries fade colour only.

motion.name: theme-scanline-wipe
motion.purpose: Theme switch wipe, disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: frame-swap
motion.purpose: Static ASCII frame fades out when the live 3D render takes over.

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Unboxed bracketed accent text. Hover shifts colour to the prose colour.
components.css: .ds-btn { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-mono); } .ds-btn:hover { color: var(--fg); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link (current)
components.description: Section link in the sticky header; reverse video when it is the current section.
components.css: .ds-nav { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; } .ds-nav:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav[aria-current='location'] { background: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); }

components.name: Process Row (selected)
components.description: htop-style project row. Selection inverts the whole row.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4ch 17ch 20ch 1fr; column-gap: 2ch; width: 100%; padding: 0 1ch; font: inherit; text-align: left; border: 0; cursor: pointer; background: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Command Line
components.description: Muted shell command that introduces each section.
components.css: .ds-cmd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5rem; color: var(--muted); } .ds-prompt { color: var(--accent); }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a real shell session: a prompt in the header, sections introduced by the command that would produce them, projects as an htop process list, experience as git log --graph, skills as neofetch. It is polished like a product site and skinned like a terminal, and the skin never costs legibility.

Depth is flat and sharp. There are no shadows, no radii, no cards. Hierarchy comes from rules, indentation on whole-ch columns, colour roles, and reverse video.
keyCharacteristics: Everything aligns to a 1.5rem vertical rhythm and whole-ch horizontal columns.
Colour is by role, not decoration.
Three themes: phosphor (default dark), amber, paper (light), all AA.

rules.name: The Role Rule
rules.body: accent = interactive, --num = numbers, --ident = names, --fg = prose, --muted = secondary. A colour is never used outside its role.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every foreground and background pair passes AA in all three themes.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: Headings are lowercase, matching the GitHub README voice.

rules.name: The Grid Rule
rules.body: Line-height is always a multiple of 1.5rem; widths are in ch.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at all times. State is shown by colour fade or reverse video, never by shadow, lift or scale.

dos: Do keep every effect optional: plain semantic HTML on first paint, reduced-motion fallbacks for decode, scroll drawing, and the 3D hero.
Do use colour by role and verify AA contrast in all three themes.
Do set widths in ch and line-heights in multiples of 1.5rem so ASCII aligns.
Do write headings lowercase and copy in the README voice: specific, dry, numbers over adjectives.
Do show interaction with reverse video or a colour fade.
donts: Don't add shadows, border radius, cards, gradients or glassmorphism.
Don't put content only in a canvas, animation or the terminal.
Don't use accent on non-interactive text or reuse number and identifier colours decoratively.
Don't use em-dashes or buzzwords in visible copy.
Don't add a photo, a contact form, or a phone number.
